description: Phobius provenance table and N-terminal topology figure for LIH1 against secreted and membrane-anchored family members
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- Provenance table 1: Phobius results (verbatim from EBI REST runs above) ----
phob = pd.DataFrame([
 ["P47145","LIH1","S. cerevisiae","query",0,"no","o",None,None,"phobius-R20261123-041526-0855-55917932-p"],
 ["P00560","PGK1","S. cerevisiae","cytosolic control",0,"no","o",None,None,"batch2"],
 ["A0ABX6F1A9","LIH1 orthologue","K. marxianus","orthologue",1,"no","i21-42o",None,None,"batch1"],
 ["P25641","ATG15","S. cerevisiae","signal anchor (TM 15-35)",1,"no","i12-34o",None,None,"batch1"],
 ["E0A7J0","LIP2","Y. lipolytica","secreted (seed comparator)",0,"yes","n3-18c27/28o",28,17,"batch1"],
 ["O42807","FAEA","A. niger","secreted, SP exp. ECO:0000269",0,"yes","n9-16c21/22o",22,21,"batch1"],
 ["P61870","MDLA","P. camemberti","secreted, SP exp. ECO:0000269",0,"yes","n3-13c18/19o",19,26,"batch1"],
 ["O59952","LIP","T. lanuginosus","secreted",0,"yes","n4-12c17/18o",18,17,"batch1"],
 ["P61872","LIP","R. oryzae","secreted",0,"yes","n7-18c26/27o",27,26,"batch1"],
 ["P19515","LIP","R. miehei","secreted",0,"yes","n10-20c24/25o",25,24,"batch2"],
 ["I1RPD9","FGL1","F. graminearum","secreted",0,"yes","n3-10c15/16o",16,15,"batch2"],
 ["A8PUY1","LIP1","M. globosa","secreted",0,"yes","n6-17c24/25o",25,19,"batch2"],
 ["Q9P451","LIPA","P. cyclopium","secreted",0,"yes","n7-15c20/21o",21,20,"batch2"],
 ["P0CT91","LIPA","S. alcalophilus","secreted",0,"yes","n9-24c32/33o",33,32,"batch2"],
 ["P00724","SUC2","S. cerevisiae","secreted control",0,"yes","n3-14c19/20o",20,None,"batch2"],
 ["P00729","PRC1","S. cerevisiae","secreted/vacuolar control",0,"yes","n3-13c18/19o",19,None,"batch2"],
], columns=["accession","gene","organism","class","phobius_TM","phobius_SP","phobius_topology",
            "phobius_cleave_after","uniprot_SIGNAL_end","ebi_job"])
phob["cleavage_agrees"]=np.where(phob.uniprot_SIGNAL_end.notna(),
       (phob.phobius_cleave_after-1==phob.uniprot_SIGNAL_end).map({True:"exact",False:"differs"}), "")
phob.to_csv("artifact_phobius_results.csv", index=False)
print("=== artifact_phobius_results.csv ===")
print(phob.to_string(index=False))

sec=phob[phob["class"].str.contains("secreted")]
print(f"\nSensitivity on secretory proteins: {(sec.phobius_SP=='yes').sum()}/{len(sec)}")
m=sec[sec.uniprot_SIGNAL_end.notna()]
print(f"Cleavage site reproduced exactly: {(m.cleavage_agrees=='exact').sum()}/{len(m)}")
print(f"Non-secretory (LIH1, PGK1): SP predicted = {(phob[phob['class'].isin(['query','cytosolic control'])].phobius_SP=='yes').sum()}/2")

# ---- Figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,6.2))
colmap={"query":"#f59e0b","cytosolic control":"#9ca3af","orthologue":"#059669",
        "signal anchor (TM 15-35)":"#be123c"}
ypos=list(range(len(phob)))[::-1]
for y,(_,r) in zip(ypos, phob.iterrows()):
    c = colmap.get(r["class"], "#2563eb")
    ax.plot([1,60],[y,y], color="#e5e7eb", lw=7, solid_capstyle="butt", zorder=1)
    if r.phobius_SP=="yes":
        cl=r.phobius_cleave_after
        ax.plot([1,cl-1],[y,y],color=c,lw=7,solid_capstyle="butt",zorder=2)
        ax.plot([cl-1,cl-1],[y-.33,y+.33],color="k",lw=1.6,zorder=3)
        ax.text(cl+1.2,y,f"SP, cleaved after {int(cl)-1}",va="center",fontsize=7.6,color="#111827")
    elif r.phobius_TM==1:
        a,b=[int(v) for v in r.phobius_topology.replace("i","").replace("o","").split("-")]
        ax.plot([a,b],[y,y],color=c,lw=7,solid_capstyle="butt",zorder=2)
        ax.text(b+1.5,y,f"transmembrane helix {a}-{b}",va="center",fontsize=7.6,color="#111827")
    else:
        ax.text(2,y,"no signal peptide, no transmembrane helix",va="center",fontsize=8,
                color="#111827",fontweight="bold" if r.accession=="P47145" else "normal")
    lab=f"{r.gene} {r.organism}"
    ax.text(-1.5,y,lab,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=8.5,
            fontweight="bold" if r.accession=="P47145" else "normal")
ax.set_xlim(-34,74); ax.set_ylim(-1,len(phob)); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xticks([1,10,20,30,40,50,60]); ax.set_xlabel("Residue position (N-terminal 60 residues)")
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
ax.set_title("Phobius topology of the N-terminal 60 residues\nLIH1 is the only Lipase_3 family member tested with neither a signal peptide nor a membrane anchor",
             fontsize=11.5, loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
